_comment: Curated metadata, keyed by file name (or path relative to the category folder). Times can be seconds or h:mm:ss. Scenes with "start": null show up as 'no time yet': play the movie, press B at the right moment and the time is filled in (E sets the end). Scene edits made in the app are saved to DATA_DIR/scenes.json and win over this file.
